F1_No_Meaningful_Failure.description: Frozen law transfers across all tests without qualification.
F1_No_Meaningful_Failure.evidence: Strict parameter transfer fails at 350 K (109.9% error, KS p < 0.0001); cross-regime transfer is partial.

F3_Relaxation_Failure.evidence: Circular autocorrelation error Delta C = 0.0161, intermediate RMSE matches training curve.

F4_Kinetic_Failure_HeldOut_T3.description: Barrier-crossing mismatch on held-out set T3 at 300 K.
F4_Kinetic_Failure_HeldOut_T3.evidence: Model mean FPT = 23.96 ps vs MD = 20.69 ps (KS p = 0.3365).

F5_Thermodynamic_Failure.evidence: KL divergence = 0.3026 nats, basin population error Delta P_A = 0.0180.

F6_Representation_Failure.evidence: Memory residual M_k(32) = 0.03113 nats < 0.05 practical threshold (increases from M_1=0.00786 to M_32=0.03113; under prespecified practical cutoff 0.05, no large residual history dependence detected).

F7_Strict_Cross_Regime_Failure.description: Frozen numerical parameters fail to predict accelerated transition kinetics at 350 K.
F7_Strict_Cross_Regime_Failure.evidence: Strict 300 K parameters predict 25.16 ps vs MD 11.99 ps (error 109.9%, KS p < 0.0001). Prescribing D ~ T (s=1.167) yields 18.76 ps (56.5% error, KS p = 0.0008). Scaling D*(z) by independently estimated local diffusion scaling a_emp = 1.471 recovers kinetics (12.99 ps, 8.4% error, KS p = 0.6330).
